About this
website

Sources, organizational criteria and information that remains to be completed.

Sources

The main source is the Lattes CV supplied by the author, updated on 16 November 2026. The content has been organized to provide access to his biography, publications, projects and courses.

  • Biography, bibliographic references and projects: Lattes CV.
  • INCT ID-ICED: institutional description and coordination: institute website.
  • Courses from 2022 to 2026: syllabi provided by the author in the Ensino and Ensino/PASSADO folders. Semesters follow the documents or the archive’s organization.
  • Semesters and links for Estudos Exemplares (2021) and Mídia e liberdade de expressão (2017): IESP–UERJ institutional profile.
  • Cover and bibliographic information for the 2026 book: Autêntica. This book was not listed in the XML’s books section.
  • Current portrait: the file “3x4_Foto JFJ.png” from the photographs supplied by the author. Photographer credit not provided.

Bibliographic references

The collection includes articles, authored or edited books, and chapters. One record with an incomplete title (“Review of”, 2023) has been excluded pending review. One chapter’s language was omitted because the source information is inconsistent.

Titles and authorship have been preserved as supplied, with punctuation and formatting adjustments to selected references. Different editions and entries with similar titles remain separate. Full-text links are provided when available in the source; the absence of a link does not mean the work is unavailable.

Information to be completed

  • Syllabi for Estudos Exemplares (2025), Seminário de tese (2025, first semester) and Política Brasileira (2023, first semester): the folders were located, but no corresponding syllabus was found. For enrollment and schedules, consult IESP–UERJ’s official course listings.
  • Photographer credit.
  • Project teams, funding and updated project status.
  • Review of incomplete references and older publication links.

English version

The website provides complete Portuguese and English versions, accessible through the PT/EN language selector. Publication and course titles retain their original wording, with clearly identified English renderings where available. Bibliographic citations remain in their original form.

Editorial design

The home page follows the author’s selected design: the book takes priority, followed by recent publications. The two original proposals remain available (in Portuguese) →
